# mtl5_bench capability card -- jetson-orin

The platform benchmark's capability cards for the `jetson-orin` machine described on the
[benchmark systems](../systems.md) page: every operation family, measured against this
machine's FMA peak and memory bandwidth (#721). This page shows the latest published
session; every session's raw results stay in the data directory.

Repeatability: 793 of 824 entries within +-5% of the previous session, measured after a cold boot on the same commit (median ratio 0.998 to 1.000 per run; benchmarks/compare_sessions.py); 27 of the 31 outside the band are 6-thread runs. Relates to #721, #737, #805 and #810.
